request: In Calamaio, C-y with an empty kill ring should say "Nothing to paste" in the echo area instead of "The kill ring is empty". Change the body of the command yank, a Lisp function in the program's killring.lisp.

set./program/killring.lisp/yank:
(defcommand yank "Inserts the last killed text at point, and sets the mark at its start."
  :title "Paste" :category "Killing"
  []
  (when (editable?)
    (if (= (count state.kills) 0)
      (message "Nothing to paste")
      (let [here (caret)]
        (deactivate)
        (set "state.arg" nil)
        (yank-at 0 {:line (:line here) :column (:column here)})))))
